news.analysis: Lamb wasn't able to connect with Prescott on over half of his targets, but he was able to make the most out of the ones that he did catch, finishing with 74 yards and two touchdowns in a comfortable win over the Eagles. He will continue to be a top-tier fantasy option moving forward, assuming he remains healthy.
news.contents: CeeDee Lamb hauled in 5-of-12 targets for 74 yards and two touchdowns in Monday night's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.title: CeeDee Lamb hauls in two touchdowns Monday

news.contents: Dallas Cowboys wide receiver CeeDee Lamb had a couple of impressive catches to help the Cowboys dismantle the banged-up Philadelphia Eagles by a score of 38-21 on Monday Night Football. Lamb was by far quarterback Dak Prescott's favorite weapon in the win, as he caught five of a team-high 12 targets for a team-high 74 yards and two touchdowns. news.analysis: Tucker has not kicked in the NFL since the 2024 season, following a much-publicized violation of the league's personal-conduct policy. He's now alongside fellow veteran kicker Harrison Butker in Kansas City. Butker has struggled a bit this season, and Tucker could win out between the two. The situation should become clearer as the practice week moves forward.
news.contents: Justin Tucker signed with the Chiefs' practice squad on Wednesday.
news.title: Justin Tucker signs with Chiefs

news.contents: The Kansas City Chiefs have signed veteran kicker Justin Tucker to their practice squad, according to The Kansas City Star's Sam McDowell. They also worked out Ben Sauls and Harrison Mevis during the week but opted for Tucker. Tucker has played 13 seasons with the Baltimore Ravens, making 89% of his kicks and earning five All-Pro and seven Pro Bowl honors.
